h1: The 6 Best Stainless Steel Air Fryers of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Stainless Steel Air Fryers: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: 6 stainless steel air fryers and air fryer ovens compared on capacity, cooking modes, basket design and counter footprint.
summary: The Breville Smart Oven Air Fryer Pro is the best stainless steel air fryer here: 13 cooking functions and super convection that the maker says cuts cook times by up to 30 percent. The Cuisinart 6-quart basket model is the pick for simple air frying. If counter space is the problem, the Ninja Flip folds away. And if you cook for a crowd, the Emeril 26-quart French door oven holds a full roast.
intro: Stainless steel on an air fryer is a design choice more than a cooking feature. It resists stains, wipes clean and looks like the rest of a stainless kitchen. What actually decides how well you cook is the format: a basket that fits a few servings, or a toaster-oven style box that also bakes and broils.

The six models here split across both formats. We looked at capacity, cooking modes, basket materials and how much counter each one takes. The ranking favors flexible machines that replace another appliance, then reliable basket fryers that do one job well.

products.name: Breville Smart Oven Air Fryer Pro
products.verdict: Brushed stainless, 13 cooking functions and super convection for faster cooking.
products.description:
Breville's Smart Oven Air Fryer Pro offers 13 cooking functions covering roasting, air frying and dehydrating, in a brushed stainless steel body. Its super convection system, according to Breville, cuts cooking time by up to 30 percent.

It leads because it replaces a toaster oven, an air fryer and a dehydrator in one footprint, which no basket model can do. The cost is size and price: it is the largest countertop box here after the Emeril, and it costs the most.

Best for a home cook who wants one stainless appliance to do everything on a countertop.
products.skipIf: You only air fry frozen snacks.

products.name: Cuisinart 6-Quart Air Fryer
products.verdict: A stainless 6-quart basket, five presets and 1800W that holds a 4-lb chicken.
products.description:
Cuisinart's basket model has a stainless housing, a dedicated 6-quart basket, bake, broil, air fry and keep warm modes, and five air-fry presets. The 1800W output holds a 4-lb chicken.

It ranks below the Breville because it cooks in a basket only, and has far fewer functions. It beats the other Cuisinart basket model on capacity, since six quarts feeds a family rather than a couple.

A good pick for a family that wants a straightforward air fryer in a stainless finish.
products.idealFor: Families who want simple air frying.

products.name: Cuisinart Air Fryer Toaster Oven
products.verdict: Eight modes, 1800W and an interior that takes up to six slices of toast.
products.description:
This Cuisinart is an air fryer toaster oven with eight cooking modes, including air fry, convection, broil and warm, driven by 1800W. The interior is spacious enough for up to six slices of bread.

It ranks third because the Breville offers more functions and a faster convection system. It wins against the basket fryers for flexibility, since it toasts, bakes and broils too.

Best for a kitchen that needs a toaster oven and an air fryer in one stainless box.
cons: Takes longer to preheat than a basket
products.idealFor: Toasting, baking and air frying in one box.

products.name: Ninja Flip Toaster Oven & Air Fryer
products.verdict: Flips up and away to save about half the counter space, with eight cooking functions.
products.description:
The Ninja Flip folds up against the wall when you are done, which Ninja says saves roughly half the counter space. It has eight cooking functions and a stainless steel finish.

That design is why it ranks fourth: no other model here solves the counter problem. It trades some capacity and function count against the Cuisinart oven and the Breville, so it suits smaller households.

A good fit for a small kitchen where every inch matters.
pros: Saves about half the counter space
products.skipIf: You cook for four or more.

products.name: Cuisinart 4-Quart Glass Basket Air Fryer
products.verdict: Stainless exterior, a PFAS-free borosilicate glass basket and a ClearView window.
products.description:
This Cuisinart has a stainless exterior and a PFAS-free borosilicate glass basket, with a ClearView window so you can watch food cook without opening it. It has five functions and a 4-quart capacity.

It ranks fifth because four quarts is small for a family, and the function list is the shortest here. What it offers is a coating-free cooking surface and a way to monitor food without losing heat.

Best for a household of one or two that wants to avoid non-stick coatings.
products.idealFor: One or two people avoiding coatings.

products.name: Emeril Lagasse 26QT French Door Air Fryer Toaster Oven
products.verdict: A 26-quart French door oven that fits a full roast in one go.
products.description:
The Emeril Lagasse oven has a 26-quart interior with French doors, combining air fryer and multi-cooker functions. The size fits a full roast at once, which a single-basket air fryer cannot.

It ranks last because it takes the most counter space, and a large box heats slowly for small jobs. Against the Breville, it offers capacity rather than precision.

Best for a family or host who cooks large meals and wants one countertop oven for them.

whatMatters.detail: A basket fryer cooks fast and is easy to clean, but holds a few servings. An oven-style model is larger and can toast, bake and broil. Choose a basket for snacks and sides, an oven for whole meals.

whatMatters.factor: Stainless is the shell, not the cooking surface
whatMatters.detail: On most air fryers the stainless steel is the outer housing, while the basket or tray inside is coated or glass. If you want to avoid non-stick coatings, look at the basket material, not the exterior.

Four quarts suits one or two people. Six quarts feeds a small family. Oven-style models run 20 quarts and above. Check the cubic feet or quarts on the listing, since a basket can fit less than the number suggests.
1800W is the common top figure for countertop units on a standard 15-amp outlet. Higher wattage heats faster. Avoid running another high-draw appliance on the same circuit at the same time.
Air fryers vent heat from the back or top. Leave a few inches around the unit and do not push it against a wall. The Ninja Flip needs extra headroom to fold up.

faq.q: Is a stainless steel air fryer healthier?
faq.a: Not by itself. Stainless is usually the outer housing. What matters for coatings is the basket or tray, like the glass basket on the Cuisinart 4-Quart.

faq.q: What is the difference between an air fryer and an air fryer oven?
faq.a: A basket air fryer cooks in a drawer. An air fryer oven is a box with racks that can also bake, broil and toast, like the Breville and Cuisinart Toaster Oven.

faq.q: How big an air fryer do I need?
faq.a: Four quarts suits one or two people, six suits a small family, and oven-style units suit larger meals. Check the listing for usable capacity.

faq.q: Can an air fryer oven replace my toaster oven?
faq.a: Yes. The Cuisinart Toaster Oven and Breville Pro both toast, bake and broil. The Cuisinart fits up to six slices of bread.
Basket fryers heat quickly, so a short preheat is enough. Oven-style models benefit from a longer preheat. Follow the maker's guidance on the presets.

faq.q: How do I clean a stainless air fryer?
faq.a: Wipe the exterior with a soft cloth and mild soap, and wash baskets or trays by hand or in the dishwasher if the listing says they are dishwasher-safe.

finalTake: For most kitchens the Breville Smart Oven Air Fryer Pro is the best stainless steel air fryer, with 13 functions and fast super convection. For simple air frying, the Cuisinart 6-Quart is the sensible basket pick. Small kitchens should look at the Ninja Flip, and anyone avoiding coatings should look at the Cuisinart 4-Quart Glass Basket. The Emeril 26QT is for large families.
